D-054 settles Content-Length lexing (split, trim, digits that fit a long, numeric compare). It does not settle the Transfer-Encoding cases the question lists: empty list elements (', chunked', 'chunked,'), a coding with parameters ('chunked;x=1'), and an empty TE value. These decide whether such a request is forwarded chunked or rejected with 400/501, which matters for request smuggling.
Framing is validated on every response before a HEAD, 204 or 304 body is skipped. relay gets the valid length or -1 (and -1 for 204), consistent with D-031.

A status outside 100..599 is INVALID_RESPONSE, consistent with the RFC 9110 section 15 valid range, even though res.status accepts 100..999 (DefaultResponse.java:368). The reason phrase comes from the adapter.

The item applies 'return false when the address cannot be parsed' to every setting. The request makes the criterion identical to whether remoteAddress() follows forwarding headers (:132) and gives true unconditionally for trustProxyHops(n>=1) (:137) and trustProxy(true) (:139). In the code, hop mode trusts the peer without parsing it (ProxyTrustSetting.java:139-141), and legacy mode follows X-Forwarded-For regardless of the peer (:91). peerTrusted() also returns false for LEGACY, so 'the same function' cannot be reused as is. Fix: false-on-unparsable applies only in CIDR mode (ProxyTrustSetting.trusted, :163); hops>=1 and legacy are true; NONE and hops 0 are false.

extra_findings.description: Proxy.to base-path grammar is undecided (AMB-8). Whether a base path such as '/a/../b', '/a;x', '/a//b', '/%2e' or one holding control characters or invalid %-escapes is accepted changes the public construction contract, and it can bring back the traversal and bypass cases that section 3.2 rejects for request paths. Proxy.to(null) is also unspecified.
extra_findings.suggested_item: [D-xxx] The base path of Proxy.to (after all trailing '/' are removed) SHALL pass the same request-target character and segment checks as section 3.2, else IllegalArgumentException. A null url SHALL throw NullPointerException.

extra_findings.description: ProxyException constructor visibility and signature are undecided (AMB-18). This is public API that the docs/api page, the API surface tests and app tests of onError depend on.
extra_findings.suggested_item: [D-xxx] ProxyException SHALL have one public constructor ProxyException(ProxyException.Kind kind, @Nullable Throwable cause), status derived from kind (502/504/503), message null.

extra_findings.description: Transfer-Encoding lexical rules are incomplete (AMB-13): empty list elements, codings with parameters ('chunked;x=1') and an empty TE value. Each one decides between chunked forwarding and a 400 or 501 rejection on requests, and INVALID_RESPONSE on responses.
extra_findings.suggested_item: [D-xxx] Transfer-Encoding SHALL be split on ',' with OWS trimmed and empty elements ignored. Coding names compare case-insensitively. A coding with parameters, or an empty overall value, counts as a non-chunked coding under the section 3.2 and 3.9 tables.

extra_findings.description: sslSocketFactory(...) on an http target is undecided (AMB-25). Under the call-time validation rule (PRD-137), it either throws IllegalArgumentException or is accepted and unused.
extra_findings.suggested_item: [D-xxx] sslSocketFactory(factory) SHALL be accepted on an http target and SHALL be unused there; null SHALL throw NullPointerException.

extra_findings.description: isFromTrustedProxy for an unparsable socket address under hop and legacy settings (the D-026 defect, AMB-26). The result must match whether remoteAddress() follows X-Forwarded-For.
extra_findings.suggested_item: Reword D-026: true when trustProxyHops(n>=1) or trustProxy(true) is the setting; in CIDR mode, true only when the socket address parses and lies inside a CIDR; false otherwise.
